answer_1.quote: We consider 3 sequence-to-sequence models for the generation task: T5-small, -base and BART ... Description generation ... produce the text, conditioned on the context and relevant claims, for instance using an auto‑regressive encoder.

answer_2.quote: we measure precision of the generated description (y_gen) with the y_ref ∈ {y*, y_inc, y_nf} ... using BLEU (unigram), ROUGE‑L and Bertscore.

answer_4.quote: We ask annotators to compare automatically extracted incongruous (but factual) descriptions with the congruous (ground‑truth) descriptions ... We collect 3 annotations for 50 samples ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are shown the article context and two descriptions and asked to give a preference on a 5‑point scale (strongly prefer description 1 to strongly prefer description 2).
